status: Pi 1.3.0 compaction preparation, automatic-trigger decisions and auto-compaction lifecycle order verified host-independently against the unchanged upstream modules; host integration of the projection model remains pending

commands: RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo test -p rpi-harness --locked --test compaction_pure

compared: Session projection: path selection (default/explicit-none/id), model and thinking-level settings, context-entry selection around the newest and older compactions, context_edit replacement and omission, custom/branch-summary/compaction message construction, null-content normalization

Token estimation: per-role char/4 estimates including UTF-16 string lengths, emoji, image blocks, system sections and toolsAdded JSON.stringify, tool-call argument serialization with escapes, bash execution and summary roles
estimateContextTokens usage selection (aborted/error/zero usage skipped) and estimateProjectedContextTokens stale-usage invalidation by context_edit/compaction

prepareCompaction: firstKeptEntryId, messagesToSummarize, turnPrefixMessages, isSplitTurn, tokensBefore, previousSummary, cumulative file operations (including fromHook suppression), recovery-omission cut advancement, missing/retain-none previous kept ids, split-turn prefixes, already-compacted and empty paths
Branch collection: common ancestor and chronological entry collection for sibling/ancestor/root/self/no-old-leaf navigation
prepareBranchEntries: newest-first budget, compaction/branch-summary grace rule, cumulative file operations and fromHook suppression
File-operation utils: assistant tool-call and tool-result nested-call extraction, insertion-ordered sets, UTF-16 sorted read/modified lists, XML formatting, and summarization-failure classification
isContextOverflow across 41 provider error strings, silent-usage and length-stop overflow, cerebras bodiless, and non-overflow throttling/rate-limit exclusions

checkCompaction decision table and ordered side effects: disabled, aborted skip, pre-compaction staleness, explicit/silent/length overflow with and without a later compaction or context edit, other-model and unprojected suppression, direct-usage/estimate/projection threshold paths, stale estimate rejection, second-attempt failure emission

autoCompaction operation order and emitted events: success, queued continuation, overflow retry, extension compaction, extension cancel, summary failure, commit failure, missing model, missing preparation, aborted signal, handler-that-returns-nothing
limits: This is a host-independent decision port over Pi-shaped JSON, not the host Entry/message enums; wiring the projection and context_edit model into crates/rpi-harness/src/session and the harness loop is separate work (H06/H10 remain partial).

Summary generation itself (LLM prompts, retries, usage merging) is not re-tested here; branch-summary-reference.json covers branch prompts and compaction prompts remain covered by the existing host tests.
Timestamps are compared as numeric epoch milliseconds; ISO-8601 string timestamps and the Date parsing they require are not exercised.
JSON.stringify of non-integral floats is validated only for the fixture values used; JS exponent formatting for very large/small magnitudes is not covered.
The overflow classifier is a hand port of the upstream regex list (no regex dependency is available in rpi-harness) and is validated against the 41-row corpus, not against arbitrary inputs.

The lifecycle order model mirrors the upstream control flow driven through stubs; the real extension runner's session_compact_failed handler gate is not modelled because the reference stubs that method.
Only Linux with Node 24.22.0 and Rust 1.78.0/default was executed.
